LanguageData.MT_SettingsPerformanceHint: Changes apply from the next rendering frame. All options are on by default. These options change drawing only; damage, targeting and power networks are unaffected.
LanguageData.MT_TeslaInstancingHint: Draws lightning segments with matching opacity together. When disabled or unsupported by the GPU, draws the same segments individually.
LanguageData.MT_TeslaParallelHint: When enough Tesla effects are visible, computes segment coordinates during the game's parallel drawing phase. When disabled or below the threshold, computes them on the main thread. Combat calculations keep their existing path.
